summary: Lloyds Banking Group plc filed a Form 6-K disclosing an open-market share repurchase of 5,000,000 ordinary shares at an average price of 99.5708 pence per share, executed via Goldman Sachs International. The buyback is part of an existing share buyback programme announced on 30 January 2026. Shares will be cancelled, reducing outstanding equity. This is a routine capital return activity under an ongoing programme, not a tender offer or special event. The filing is a foreign private issuer report under Rule 13a-16. What to watch: continuation of the buyback programme and its impact on EPS and capital ratios.
